test_grpc_python_plugin: test the gRPC Python protoc plugin by running the PythonPluginTest unittest suite with all RPC call types
create_grpc_service: create a gRPC service with UnaryCall, StreamingOutputCall, StreamingInputCall, FullDuplexCall, and HalfDuplexCall methods using _ServicerMethods
test_unary_call_future: test the UnaryCall future API by invoking stub.UnaryCall.future() and verifying async response, timeout, and cancellation behavior
test_streaming_output_call: test the StreamingOutputCall RPC by sending a request with response parameters and verifying streamed responses match expected output
test_full_duplex_call: test the FullDuplexCall RPC by sending a request iterator and verifying bidirectional streaming responses match expected output
